acceptanceCriteria: The owner records a group size or capacity target in a decision.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. With group size 1 each merge_group run takes the full suite (~40 min today), allowing ~36 merges/day against ~15/day observed with bursts. Decision 0431 does not set a group size or capacity target. Owner decision needed; ship Batch 1 CI speedups before enabling the queue.
title: question: merge-queue group size or capacity target once V1-0812 is enabled
